source: Hawley monitoring-data workbook, Figure 5 post-retrofit lookup data and Figure 6 held-out monitored events
validation_scope: screening of known-inflow S(H)-Q(H) storage routing only; no generic physical-outlet geometry validation

admissibility.status: not accepted as a formal independent validation dataset for this application
admissibility.reason: Figure 5 has no event-date key that joins its S(H)/Q(H) records to Figure 6's monitored events. The outlet geometry and coefficient history are also not supplied. The numerical comparisons are therefore retained as a reproducible data-consistency screen, not reported as a model-validation pass or failure.
